title: Extend a training handle and engage its detent
context: Adjustable assistive equipment must lock at a selected setting before release. This unoccupied training module tests pin withdrawal and measured extension followed by positive pin engagement. Extension alone does not earn full credit. It is a tabletop mechanism and must never support a person.
scoring: Score zero if extension is between 5 mm and 75 mm while pin retraction is 45 mm or less. The green pin must retract more than 45 mm before handle extension exceeds 5 mm. Extension beyond 5 mm before this unlock makes the entire episode score zero. A correct unlock earns 0.25. Extension within 2 mm of 80 mm earns 0.5 after the unlock. Pin retraction below 2 mm and handle speed below 4 mm per second raises this to 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: This is a rigid printed training module with no human load. The slider and locking pin are separate passive articulations with physical contact. The handle has two actual transverse rectangular openings. The pin fits into the selected opening and blocks extension by contact. The pin spring stiffness is 35 newtons per metre with damping 0.8 and maximum force 2.5 newtons. The model does not represent structural load capacity or clinical suitability.
instruction: Retract the green locking pin with the left arm. Extend the blue training aid handle to the white 80 mm mark with the right arm. Return the pin into the second hole. Release both grippers with the handle locked at that length. No person is present and the module must not support a person.
setup: Use the official bimanual YAM station. The tabletop is at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. All props are rigid PA12 polymer prototypes. All joint positions start at zero. The adjustable handle has an initial outer envelope of 340 by 90 by 120 mm. Its authored root is at x 140 mm and y -30 mm and z 807.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The locking pin has an initial outer envelope of 80 by 174 by 109 mm. Its authored root is at x 140 mm and y 25 mm and z 807.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The length mark has an initial outer envelope of 3 by 25 by 1 mm. Its authored root is at x 320 mm and y -75 mm and z 748 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The inventory lists each collider and body mass and joint anchor and travel limit. Local solid positions are measured from the named body root. Outer envelope sizes describe the reset pose.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 120 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
